name: EA / Origin (anadius Denuvo/Origin Emulator)
notes: Selected when .\__Installer\installerdata.xml exists in the game root - the standard marker every EA/Origin installer leaves behind, unlike Goldberg/Uplay which are detected by a loader DLL. Achievement data is resolved independently (AE_STEAM_SCHEMA=0): origin_helper.py + get_token.py (already a standalone, tested tool - see adapters\ea_origin_emulator\origin_helper.py) parse installerdata.xml, cross-reference the game's own cross-listed Steam release on isthereanydeal.com/SteamDB for achievement names, and write anadius.cfg plus a small _origin_helper_meta.txt (steam_appid/content_id/display_name) directly into the game root. The Jokerverse export (modify_joker_json.ps1) reads that metadata file rather than re-deriving the Steam appid itself, since Jokerverse tracks EA games under platform:"steam" using their cross-listed Steam appid, not EA's own ContentId (confirmed against a real anadius-generated Need for Speed Unbound entry).
